scenarios.name: Open and close an empty browser search in a part

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the model browser is visible with no search field open
an empty search field appears beneath the browser header
the field shows the placeholder "Type Keyword"
the browser tree and solid remain visible
the user closes the empty search field
the browser tree and solid remain visible
